Overall: one backyard location (red-brick house, wooden fence, hedge, conifers, overcast soft daylight, lifted blacks). One subject, same outfit throughout (jacket, white tee, black cargo trousers, white chunky sneakers, glasses). Cameras are locked/static phone shots; all energy comes from the edit: zoom-blur landings, whip smears, spin-in roll, collage cards, cream flash-cuts after the drop. Titles: League-Gothic-style tall condensed italic caps, warm white, slight shadow, pop in (overshoot from big to small over ~3 frames).

0.00-1.00 s (p1): #0 1-frame teaser chest-up with finger to temple; #1 1-frame zip/hand detail. #2-29 ground-level shoe stepping onto grass, zoom-blur landing #2-6 then static. #30-54 laces close-up, zoom-blur landing #30-32 (cut on b0 = 0.5 s). #55 1-frame worm's-eye insert, #56 1-frame bird's-eye insert. #57- dutch wide, spin-in with rotational/radial blur.
1.00-2.00 s (p2): dutch wide standing hands in pockets, roll settling from ~-25° to ~-5°. "WORD ONE" pops at #62 lower third (~0.79 h), small italic caps. #103-105 zoom-through out of the wide, title smears with it. #106-108 tail of the zoom-through (straighter, radially blurred wide; part of the transition, detector logged it as a separate 3-frame shot). #109 cut to chest-up finger-to-temple stare, zoom landing, then static hold.
2.00-3.00 s (p3): temple hold to #154. #155 1-frame horizontal whip smear of the face. #156-159 vertical whip landing on worm's-eye full body against sky. "WORD TWO" pops #160, mid-frame (~0.55 h), smaller.
3.00-4.00 s (p4): worm's-eye hold with title to #204. #205 cut to the plain wide (slight dutch) — collage background. First card (temple stare) slides in from left at top-left ~#211-216, white thin border, drop shadow. Second card (bird's-eye face) slides in from right ~#237-240.
4.00-5.00 s (p5): cards hold with slow push; third card (sneaker crop, polaroid with thicker bottom border) slides up from bottom ~#262-268; fourth card (head turn, hair swing) slides in from right ~#286-289. Around #290 the top-left card swaps to the worm's-eye shot and the second card to a head-turn frame.
5.00-6.00 s (p6): #305 cut to spin: full body from the side, arms out, zoom-blur landing #305-309, slow turn to back view through #354. #355 cut: same spin continues on pure black background (subject matte), motion blurred landing.
6.00-7.00 s (p7): spin on black continues, turning from back to side to front (~#395-404 facing the camera). #405 cut to waist-down walk toward camera, zoom-blur landing #405-409, steady walk.
7.00-8.00 s (p8): walk continues to #454. #455 hard cut to extreme close-up, finger pushing glasses up the nose bridge, eyes on lens. "WORD THREE" pops at #460 low in frame (~0.82 h). Music thins/breaks before the drop.
8.00-9.00 s (p9): #489 DROP (8.15 s): cream flash-cut (#489-494, warm #F3EACD wash over everything incl. text) onto the same glasses close-up later in the clip (smirk); "MAIN" giant slam word at ~0.77 h. #505 (b19, 8.417 s) cream flash-cut to bird's-eye face looking up; "CHARACTER" giant, spans width. #530 (8.83 s) black frame, then three vertical strips of the waist-down walk wipe in (staggered top-to-bottom slides) #531-536 and hold as three clones.
9.00-10.00 s (p10): three clone strips hold to #554. #555 (b21) cream flash-cut to worm's-eye low angle, holds. #580 (b22) horizontal whip landing on head turn (hair swings out) #580-586, settles facing lens.
10.00-11.00 s (p11): head-turn hold to #604. #605 (b23) cream flash-cut to zip-pull close-up, hand pulling zip up with shake and slight roll. #630 (b24) zoom-blur landing on wide chair shot: subject walks to a white plastic chair and sits #630-679.
11.00-12.00 s (p12): #680 (b26) whip landing: head turn on pure black background (matte), hair settles. #705 (b27) cream flash-cut to waist-down walk; "ENERGY" pops #712 low (~0.83 h).
12.00-13.00 s (p13): walk + ENERGY holds to #754. #755 (b29) zoom-blur landing on temple stare, hold.
13.00-14.00 s (p14): #780 (b30) defocus landing on bird's-eye face, slight roll. #805 (b31) cream flash-cut to laces close-up. #825 (13.75 s) 5-frame insert of the dutch standing wide. #830 (b32) defocus landing on glasses close-up with smirk.
14.00-15.00 s (p15): #855 (b33) whip landing on head turn, hold. #880 (b34) zoom-blur landing on chair shot, leaning back in the chair.
15.00-16.43 s (p16-17): #905 (b35) cream flash-cut (longest, ~0.2 s) to frontal symmetric 'throne' hold seated legs crossed; small "WORD FOUR" title at top (~0.12 h) from ~#917 with a black slanted banner/shadow behind; holds to end #985.

Base directory for this skill: /HOME/.claude-claude2/skills/comfy-debug

When something fails on the comfy CLI, **read the JSON envelope first**, act on the `hint`, and only go deeper if needed. This skill is the bottom-up playbook.

## The envelope is the source of truth

Every command emits the standard JSON envelope (see core skill). When `error` is present, map `error.code` to a fix below.

Three rules:

1. **Map `error.code` to a fix below.** Most codes have a one-line resolution.
2. **`hint` is authoritative.** If it says "run: comfy launch", that's the fix. Don't paraphrase, don't guess.
3. **`details` carries the why.** Look here before scrolling logs.

## Decision tree for common failures

### `server_not_running` (local)
```
comfy launch              # start the local server in the foreground
# or, for background mode:
comfy launch --background
```
If `comfy launch` itself fails: check `comfy --json env` for the resolved interpreter and workspace, and inspect whatever stdout `comfy launch` was attached to.

### `cloud_not_configured` / `cloud_unauthorized` (cloud)
```
comfy cloud login                   # opens browser, OAuth + PKCE
# or, if you already have an API key:
comfy cloud set-key --key sk-…      # alternative path; API key is a fallback, not an override
comfy --json cloud whoami           # confirm signed_in: true (auth_method is "oauth" or "api_key")
```
Auth precedence is **OAuth-first**: a live `comfy cloud login` session outranks `COMFY_CLOUD_API_KEY` env, which outranks a stored key. `comfy cloud whoami` shows which credential is active. If a stale session is causing 401s, `comfy cloud logout && comfy cloud login` — setting an API key will NOT override a live session.
If you're on a custom env (PR preview), set the base URL first:
```
comfy cloud set-base-url https://fe-pr-NNNNN.testenvs.comfy.org
```
**Do not confuse this with `transient_auth` (below).** `cloud_unauthorized` happens before submission (your CLI session); an "Unauthorized" that appears as a *job failure* is the server-side token expiry and re-login does nothing.

### `transient_auth` (cloud job failed with "Unauthorized: Please login first to use this node")
An API node's **server-side** session token expired mid-execution. It is transient and has nothing to do with your local credentials — `comfy cloud login` will NOT fix it, and your auth was fine at submit time (often it strikes minutes into a long render, sometimes a whole batch at once).
```
comfy --json run --workflow same_workflow.json --where cloud   # just resubmit — succeeds on retry
```
If several jobs from one batch died together with this code, resubmit them all; one retry each is normally enough.

### `workflow_not_api_format`
UI-format workflows are converted to API format **client-side** using object_info (no server conversion endpoint exists). If conversion fails with `conversion_error`, re-export via `File > Export (API)` in ComfyUI; if object_info can't be fetched (`cql_no_graph`), retry (it's fetched live — check cloud sign-in/connection) or start a local server.

### `workflow_invalid_json`
The file isn't valid JSON. Inspect the first/last 100 bytes — often it's an HTML error page that was saved with `.json`.

### `prompt_rejected` (server returned `node_errors`)
The server validated the workflow and rejected nodes. The full per-node error map is in `details.node_errors`. The two most common causes:

- **Unknown class_type** → the cloud or local server lacks the custom node. Run:
  ```
  comfy --json nodes search MissingNodeName
  ```
  If `data.count` is 0 — or `data.close_match` is true, meaning the search found nothing and fell back to similarly-named classes — the node is genuinely absent. Then either install via `comfy node install <pkg>` (local) or pick a different workflow (cloud).

- **Missing model file** (`ckpt_name`, `lora_name`, `vae_name` not found) → confirm the loader node exists and see its choices:
  ```
  comfy --json nodes show CheckpointLoaderSimple   # inputs[].choices lists available checkpoints
  comfy --json env

**Editor:** http://127.0.0.1:59387/?project=20261017-hype-energy-leather-jacket-hero-a577

**What it is:** a remix using the hype-energy preset, set to the reference's track and its 144 BPM cut map. He's introduced as an ordinary guy on an empty rooftop car park on a grey day, with the captions JUST A GUY → ON A ROOFTOP → OR IS HE?. At the 8.15 s drop, cream flash-cuts bring in MAIN / CHARACTER / ENERGY, followed by three cloned walk strips, whip and zoom-blur landings, a four-card photo collage and a zip-pull shake. It ends on him seated in a white plastic chair under THRONE SECURED. The cuts match the reference exactly, and it passed the tool's energy comparison with the reference.

His face, hair, black leather jacket and white tee hold in every shot. Nothing from the reference footage is reused except the audio. Generation used about 12 of your 25 GPU minutes.

- **Backend failure:** after the spin clip, every submission failed, including Wan clips that had worked minutes earlier. Backend status still reports healthy, and the error carries no detail. As a result:

- **Lower half:** the subject photo stops at the chest, so I chose black slim jeans and black boots and kept them the same throughout.

If the backend comes back, the missing clips and mattes can be submitted from the saved plan and swapped into the existing timeline without redoing the rest.
